figures.title: A concise, learner-facing figure title
figures.desc: A complete description of the relationship the figure makes visible.
figures.caption: A visible interpretation cue that tells the learner what to inspect.
figures.transcript: Input enters the first stage. The operator makes the named move. Evidence at the final stage determines the next action.

figures.title: A mechanism comparison
figures.desc: The exact distinction a learner should be able to inspect.
figures.caption: The evidence-bearing difference between the two patterns.
figures.transcript: The left side shows the weak pattern and its observable consequence. The right side shows the stronger pattern and the evidence it preserves.

figures.title: A diagnostic decision surface
figures.desc: How evidence changes the operator’s next move.
figures.caption: Read across the signal row, then choose the move that fits the consequence of error.
figures.transcript: The matrix crosses signal strength with consequence. Weak signals call for a probe at low cost and a hold at high cost. Strong signals permit continuation at low cost and verification at high cost.
